## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -15.86%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing while HYG/LQD signal CREDIT STRESS ↓ (credit stress rising) and narrow sector breadth create conflicting signals, supporting CAUTION.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -15.86%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress rising per HYG/LQD (Credit Spread Level 0.7498, 1W: -0.11% | 1M: +0.29%) CORRECTION. Consumer cycle strength supportive: Consumer Cycle (1W: +1.40% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP (Dollar proxy) (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +0.04%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +0.50%) ABOVE TREND leave SPY/TLT effectively flat (Stocks vs Bonds 1W: +0.38% | 1M: +1.79%) ABOVE TREND — financial conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leadership narrow: XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND and Communication (XLC proxy) (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +8.07%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, while XLE (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +6.31%) CORRECTION and XLU (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -4.32%) BELOW TREND lag; Style: Growth/momentum leading but narrow.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms on breadth lean: SPY (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +3.73%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -2.77%) BELOW TREND; EEM (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +5.58%) ABOVE TREND but China weakness remains a drag.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation elevated but bifurcated: IBIT (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +19.62%) ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +26.60%) ABOVE TREND show risk appetite, while ARKK (1W: -1.88% | 1M: +16.04%) CORRECTION and IWM (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION show selective weakness.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Agriculture leadership: WEAT (1W: +10.19% | 1M: +13.73%) ABOVE TREND and CORN (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +12.33%) ABOVE TREND; industrial reflation signals mixed as CPER (1W: -0.80% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION and GLD (1W: -3.42% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION show short-term profit taking.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +6.31%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION, while natural gas UNG (1W: +3.40% | 1M: +3.20%) ABOVE TREND is strong.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: XLK (1W & 1M positive) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W & 1M positive) ABOVE TREND. Divergences: multiple 1W negative vs 1M positive names (GLD, SLV, ARKK, XLE, XBI) constitute MINOR divergence concentrated in themes and cyclicals, not a MAJOR regime-break across SPY/XLK/TLT/XLF.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Under CAUTION favor selective exposure to areas showing strength (XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +19.62%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to small-cap/sensitive cyclicals (IWM (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION, XLE (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +6.31%) CORRECTION); bonds (TLT (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +0.50%) ABOVE TREND) remain a constructive ballast.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND, Communication (XLC proxy) (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +8.07%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +6.31%) CORRECTION, IWM (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: WEAT (1W: +10.19% | 1M: +13.73%) ABOVE TREND, CORN (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +12.33%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -3.42% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION, BNO (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (current VXX 18.36) as complacency threshold. HYG/LQD ~0.75 (Credit Spread Level 0.7498) as credit health pivot. Tech vs Financials XLK/XLF ~3.20 (current 3.1960) for leadership tilt.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, narrow leadership with XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND and select risk assets (IBIT (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +19.62%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength. Key risk is mixed signals — falling VXX amid rising credit stress (HYG/LQD) and multiple 1W vs 1M divergences to monitor.
